books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.synopsis: An envoy from a galactic union travels to Gethen, a frozen world whose people have no fixed gender. As he navigates court intrigue and an unlikely friendship, his assumptions about loyalty and identity begin to thaw.

books.title: Never Let Me Go
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: Kathy looks back on her years at Hailsham, an idyllic English boarding school, and slowly pieces together what its students were really being raised for. A quiet, devastating novel about memory, love and what makes a life.

books.title: Station Eleven
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.synopsis: Twenty years after a pandemic collapses civilization, a troupe of actors and musicians travels the Great Lakes performing Shakespeare. Their story weaves back to a famous actor's death on the night the world ended.

books.title: The Remains of the Day
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: Stevens, an aging English butler, takes a rare road trip and reflects on decades of devoted service. Along the way, the cost of his restraint, in work and in love, comes painfully into focus.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.synopsis: Piranesi lives in the House, an endless labyrinth of marble halls and statues washed by tides. He records its wonders in his journals, until clues begin to suggest there is another world beyond it.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.synopsis: Klara, an Artificial Friend with a gift for observation, is chosen by a sickly teenage girl. Watching the family she now serves, she tries to understand the human heart and what she might do to save it.

books.title: The Road
books.author: Cormac McCarthy
books.synopsis: A father and his young son walk south through a burned, ash-covered America, carrying everything they own. Spare and harrowing, it's a story of survival and the fierce love that keeps them going.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.synopsis: Ged, a gifted and proud young wizard, unleashes a shadow upon the world while showing off. He must hunt it across the islands of Earthsea, and learn that some battles can only be won by facing yourself.
